# Step - l_trim

`l_trim` · `lTrim` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Removes leading whitespace (Unicode White_Space) from each string.

## Forms

```text
l_trim()
l_trim(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("  a ").l_trim().next()   // a 
```
